name: Customer At Risk Analysis
query:
SELECT 
    name, customer_name, sales_stage, expected_closing, 
    opportunity_amount, probability, 
    (opportunity_amount * probability / 100) AS forecasted_revenue, 
    owner, status
FROM 
    tabOpportunity
WHERE 
    status != 'Lost' 
    AND probability < 50
ORDER BY 
    expected_closing ASC;
